title: Verify failed catalog disk replacement preserves the active owner
changes: Add a focused current-dataset disk attachment test for a missing compact catalog and a structurally valid edited catalog with a matching manifest file hash.
validation: The e127-d126 Wine test confirms both disk replacements are rejected with the same owner and exact machine state, the existing owner still serves a catalog byte, and a fresh machine attaches and reads the untouched committed generation.

Current-source Windows release test compilation and selected source/executable identity pass; runtime input guards pass and successful test scratch was removed. Evidence: target/validation/units/rvr19-disk-replacement-build-2aa39q12/ and target/validation/units/rvr19-disk-replacement-e127-udu8zj00/.
Consumed successful build scratch was retired after host open-file, lease and inventory checks; evidence and receipt remain in target/validation/units/rvr19-disk-replacement-build-2aa39q12/.
limitations: This covers disk attachment failure, not a generation-write interruption, complete ordinary use, native Windows, Linux, USA or performance.
